title: /stats route may need grade-level guard
body: The /stats page (src/app/(frontend)/stats/page.tsx) uses getMeUser for auth checking but does NOT use RequireCourseSelection. This means an authenticated user without gradeLevel can access the stats dashboard. If the intent is that /stats also requires persona completion, add RequireCourseSelection wrapper. The issue description says all 4 routes (/study, /practice, /ask, /stats) redirect to /start, but /stats was only fixed if its issue was the homepage chain redirect via missing grade.
rationale: The issue says all 4 routes redirect to /start, but /stats has different auth logic. Verify the fix is complete for /stats or open a separate issue.
